summary: CAIR Action lists Wilson as a general-election preferred candidate, a tier below full endorsement in an organization whose recommendations weigh civil-rights and Gaza/ceasefire positions. That signal is complicated by her recorded Aye on AB 715 (2025), which creates an antisemitism coordinator and classroom-material oversight in California schools. The recommendation and the education-legislation vote pull in opposite directions, placing Wilson in a middle position rather than clearly on the side of Palestinian justice or clearly pro-Israel.
